|lore=The high command of the Emperor’s fleet is selected as much for loyalty and obedience as for martial skills. A wise admiral knows better than to question Palpatine.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Once per game, if opponent just played an Interrupt, may stack it here. To play any new Interrupt of same name, players must first stack it here. May place this Effect in Lost Pile (place cards here in owners’ Used Pile) to retrieve a starship. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The [[Something Special Planned For Them (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (Original 2005)|2005 Gold Edition wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The remaster requires the opponent to have just played the stackable Interrupt and allows retrieval of a starship. Gold allows an Interrupt just played and retrieves specifically an Imperial starship into hand.
